title: Welcome to Digi World
question: Which opening should greet players as the camera follows the neighborhood path?

options.label: Skyline Story
options.thesis: A bright, oversized hello lives in the open sky while the neighborhood stays the hero.
options.viewport: Welcome to Digi World stretches across the upper sky; a short invitation sits below it, and the existing Play action appears at the bottom after the first camera beat. The title settles into a small corner mark before the flight ends.
options.risk: The text needs a subtle sky tint behind it when the camera crosses brighter scenery.

options.label: Route Ribbon
options.thesis: A friendly route strip grounds the welcome in the road the camera is exploring.
options.viewport: The upper view is completely open. A broad cream ribbon follows the lower edge, carrying the welcome on the left, a tiny path motif through the center, and Play on the right. It can slide away when the flight reaches its destination.
options.risk: A tall ribbon could cover too much of the road on smaller displays.

options.label: Storybook Window
options.thesis: The street becomes a living picture inside a warm invitation card.
options.viewport: A roomy, centered cream frame names Digi World above a wide live window into the moving neighborhood. One sentence and a clear Play button sit underneath. The frame opens outward and disappears as the journey begins.
options.risk: It briefly hides more of the 3D world, so its opening transition must be quick and graceful.
